title: grammitis integripaleata
intro: Grammitis integripaleata, commonly known as the Pale-stemmed Grammitis, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Grammitis integripaleata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory problems, and promote the expulsion of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
